title: My Stepdaughter Forged My Signature, Sold My Seeds. So I Voided The Sale, She Labels My Sauce.
description: After my stepdaughter forged my signature, dissolved our seed-saving partnership, and sold the brand for $580K, I discovered the notarized contract hidden in my dad's heirloom tomato seeds. I voided the fraudulent sale and now she hand-labels jars of my sauce wearing an apron that says 'Rotten to the Core.' #revenge #familybetrayal #saucebusiness
thumb_text: SHE FORGED MY SIGNATURE, SOLD MY SEEDS, NOW SHE LABELS MY SAUCE
pinned_comment: If you had found a notarized contract tucked inside your late father's packet of Mortgage Lifter seeds, proving your stepdaughter forged your name to steal your life's work, what would you have done? Share your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: I INVESTED MY $89,000 PENSION IN A SEED LIBRARY WITH MY STEPDAUGHTER
